title: diphyes myrtillus
intro: Diphyes myrtillus, commonly known as the bilberry, is a type of shrub that belongs to the heath family (Ericaceae). The bilberry is rich in antioxidants and has been used for centuries to treat various health conditions, including digestive issues and inflammation. The plant's therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of the bilberry include anthocyanins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
